implementation_restore_note: Recommitted unchanged scientific parameters after parent-branch cleanup; the prior workflow stopped at contract-file lookup and no V1.66 scoring occurred.
research_question: For the 3-day horizon, is temporal weakness better explained and repaired by probability recalibration alone or by recency-weighted refitting alone, relative to the unchanged static parent, before any gated adaptation, selector, or drift detector is introduced?

source_artifact.immutability: Use the frozen V1.64 artifact only. No panel reconstruction or external data fetch is allowed.

variants.RECAL_ONLY: Causal rolling constrained logistic recalibration of STATIC probability using only matured prior forecast outcomes; no parent refit.
variants.FORGET_ONLY: Frozen V1.64 exponentially weighted parent refit probability; no residual error correction and no recalibration.

recalibration.objective: binary log loss plus fixed shrinkage to identity calibration a=0,b=1
recalibration.fallback: STATIC if support is insufficient, only one realized class is present, or optimizer fails

evaluation.family_level_interpretation: A mechanism is considered promising only if at least one parent passes the complete frozen gate and no post-score parameter search is performed. Cross-parent consistency is reported but not required for the primary gate.

decision_lock.if_recal_only_passes: Proceed to a separately frozen gated-calibration/correction study; do not add drift detection yet.
decision_lock.if_forget_only_passes: Proceed to a separately frozen recency-adaptive robustness study; do not add selector or residual correction yet.
decision_lock.if_both_pass: Compare stability and simplicity under a new frozen contract; no ad-hoc hybrid in V1.66.
decision_lock.if_neither_passes: Stop adaptation mechanism escalation for the current 3D information set and return to signal/information redesign or a newly justified hypothesis.
